001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.types;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.BaseSensorGhost;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GBFollow;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GBGoAwayFrom;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GBITooClose;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhostManager;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Tags;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.world.MoteParticleScript;
012
013public class ZigguratGhost extends BaseSensorGhost {
014
015        public ZigguratGhost(SensorGhostManager manager) {
016                super(manager, 30);
017                
018                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
019                //initEntity(1000f, 200f);
020                initEntity(2000f, pf.getRadius());
021                if (!placeNearPlayer(700f, 1200f)) {
022                        setCreationFailed();
023                        return;
024                }
025                
026                entity.addScript(new MoteParticleScript(entity, 0.1f));
027                entity.addTag(Tags.ZIG_GHOST);
028                
029                addBehavior(new GBFollow(pf, 1000f, 15, 800f, 1500f));
030                //addBehavior(new GBIRunEveryFrame(0f, this));
031                addInterrupt(new GBITooClose(0f, pf, 300f));
032                addBehavior(new GBGoAwayFrom(10f, pf, 50));
033        }
034
035}
